Performance.Name: Set Visual Effects to Best Performance
Performance.Description: Disables animations, shadows, and other UI effects to improve responsiveness on lower-end hardware.

Performance.Name: Enable Ultimate Performance Power Plan
Performance.Description: Unlocks and activates the hidden Ultimate Performance power scheme.

Performance.Name: Disable Nagle's Algorithm
Performance.Description: Reduces network latency for real-time applications by disabling TCP packet coalescing.

Apply.Command: Get-ChildItem 'HKLM:\SYSTEM\CurrentControlSet\Services\Tcpip\Parameters\Interfaces' | ForEach-Object { Set-ItemProperty -Path $_.PSPath -Name 'TcpAckFrequency' -Value 1 -Type DWord -Force; Set-ItemProperty -Path $_.PSPath -Name 'TCPNoDelay' -Value 1 -Type DWord -Force }

Undo.Command: Get-ChildItem 'HKLM:\SYSTEM\CurrentControlSet\Services\Tcpip\Parameters\Interfaces' | ForEach-Object { Remove-ItemProperty -Path $_.PSPath -Name 'TcpAckFrequency' -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue; Remove-ItemProperty -Path $_.PSPath -Name 'TCPNoDelay' -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue }

Performance.Name: Disable Hibernation
Performance.Description: Frees disk space equal to your RAM size by disabling the hibernation file.

Privacy.Name: Disable Telemetry & Diagnostic Data
Privacy.Description: Sets diagnostic data collection to the minimum level allowed and disables the telemetry service.

Privacy.Name: Disable Advertising ID
Privacy.Description: Stops apps from using an advertising ID to personalize ads across apps.

Privacy.Name: Disable Activity History
Privacy.Description: Stops Windows from tracking and syncing your app/document activity history.

Explorer.Name: Show File Extensions
Explorer.Description: Always show file extensions in File Explorer.

Explorer.Name: Show Hidden Files
Explorer.Description: Shows hidden files and folders in File Explorer.

Explorer.Name: Restore Classic Right-Click Menu (Win11)
Explorer.Description: Removes the trimmed-down Windows 11 context menu in favor of the full classic one.

Explorer.Name: Set File Explorer to Open to 'This PC'
Explorer.Description: Changes the default Explorer launch view from Quick Access to This PC.

Debloat.Name: Remove Xbox Apps
Debloat.Description: Removes Xbox-related bundled apps (does not affect ability to play PC games).

Undo.Message: Reinstall from Microsoft Store manually; Appx removal is not auto-reversible.

Debloat.Name: Remove Cortana
Debloat.Description: Removes the Cortana app and disables its background service.

Undo.Message: Reinstall from Microsoft Store manually; Appx removal is not auto-reversible.

Debloat.Name: Remove 3D Viewer / Mixed Reality Portal
Debloat.Description: Removes rarely used 3D/mixed reality bundled apps.

Undo.Message: Reinstall from Microsoft Store manually; Appx removal is not auto-reversible.

Debloat.Name: Remove OneDrive
Debloat.Description: Uninstalls OneDrive and removes it from File Explorer's sidebar.

Undo.Message: Download and reinstall OneDrive from microsoft.com if needed.

Debloat.Name: Remove Bing-Integrated Apps
Debloat.Description: Removes Bing News, Weather, and Finance bundled apps.

Undo.Message: Reinstall from Microsoft Store manually; Appx removal is not auto-reversible.

Debloat.Name: Remove Microsoft Edge (Advanced/Risky)
Debloat.Description: WARNING: Removing Edge can break some WebView2-dependent apps and Windows components. Only use if you understand the risk.

Undo.Message: Reinstall Edge from microsoft.com/edge if needed.

Updates.Name: Disable Automatic Windows Updates
Updates.Description: Sets Windows Update service to manual start, stopping automatic background updates.

Updates.Name: Enable Optional Driver Updates via Windows Update
Updates.Description: Allows Windows Update to also offer optional driver updates.

Updates.Name: Reset Windows Update Components
Updates.Description: Stops update services, clears the SoftwareDistribution cache, and restarts services — fixes many stuck-update issues.

Apply.Command: Stop-Service wuauserv,bits,cryptsvc -Force; Rename-Item "$env:windir\SoftwareDistribution" "SoftwareDistribution.bak" -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue; Start-Service wuauserv,bits,cryptsvc

Undo.Message: This action is not reversible; a fresh SoftwareDistribution folder will be recreated automatically.
